en.headline: 75-year-old dies five days after To Kwa Wan minibus collision
en.dek: Wong was struck on 13 August at the junction of Lok Shan Road and Maidstone Road by a private minibus belonging to a social-service centre; the driver remains under investigation.
body: A 75-year-old man died on Tuesday afternoon after being struck by a private minibus in To Kwa Wan five days earlier, police said.

The collision occurred at about 10 a.m. on 13 August at the junction of Lok Shan Road and Maidstone Road. The minibus, which carried markings of the Christian Family Service Centre, hit the pedestrian, surnamed Wong, as he crossed the road. Wong suffered head injuries and was taken unconscious to Queen Elizabeth Hospital. He was pronounced dead at 2.55 p.m. on 18 August.

A 52-year-old male driver, also surnamed Wong, was earlier arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm. The Christian Family Service Centre confirmed the vehicle was one of its rehabilitation buses and said only the driver was on board at the time. The centre said it is fully assisting the police investigation.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣75歲翁捱復康小巴撞 留醫五日後不治
zh.dek: 事主8月13日於落山道與美善同道交界被基督教家庭服務中心私家小巴撞倒，頭部受傷昏迷，延至18日下午不治；52歲司機早前涉危駕被捕。
body: 警方表示，一名75歲姓黃男子於周二下午不治，他於五日前面在土瓜灣被一輛私家小巴撞倒。
意外發生於8月13日上午約10時，落山道與美善同道交界。涉事小巴車身印有「基督教家庭服務中心」字樣，當時正右轉入美善同道期間撞到過路的黃姓老翁。事主頭部受傷昏迷，由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院搶救，延至18日下午2時55分證實不治。
警方早前以涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害拘捕52歲姓黃男司機。基督教家庭服務中心確認涉事為該中心復康巴士，當時車上只有司機一人，司機並無受傷，中心會全力協助警方調查。
